name: The user's split: 2R donut pointer + shoulder-side wire-race C-slide for humeral twist
verdict: screened, NOT converged (gate: +13.44 score over the 2nd half, +5.68 over the last third, top-5 within 1.06): best gap 69.84 (score 74.60) on Bench(60,160) fast with the skin-fitted saddle band - level with the spherical 3R champion (68.93 / 74.93) but behind the verified leaders (rail-elbow 64.7, seed-offset-3r-slides 66.47 on Bench(110,360)); the spec's cylindrical band scores 173-178 (band floats 30 mm). Reach 0.50 is the ceiling: the twist window holds 98 deg while the workspace needs ~150-180
limiter: (1) twist travel vs the torso: the shoe's angle in the pointing frame needs 165 deg for 90 % of the bench poses (178 on the workspace; arm directions within 15 deg differ by a median 135 deg of twist - intrinsic to any 2R pointing law), but a band fixed in the pointing frame has only a ~150-180 deg torso-free sector at s 120-160 (the other 180-210 deg are blocked by chest / axilla / head in 25-60 % of the poses): the best window is 98 deg -> reach 0.50 (red team: rest IR q3 112, abd 60 IR 92, abd 75 ER -55, overhead flexion 104, behind-back -69 all outside it); (2) the shoe rides the track at the band's highest point: 27-31 mm off the arm in every pose (in band 0.00); (3) J1 hub on the pointer pole p*: the overhead arm comes within 31-39 deg, hub 1 -15.7 mm and link 1 -14.7 mm inside the deltoid at abduction 150 (contact), and >= 31.7 mm off the skin everywhere else (in band 0.02)
note: Bench(60,160) fast grid, K3 march, K2 dense (values + axes), K6 + band/shoe outer faces contact-checked, audit clean (honest); best k 375 of 479; model v2: saddle band (skin-fitted body under a circular wire track), spec neck down the arm (the K7 neck to BOTTOM's bar crosses the band: collisions), sigma -1; sweep = 212 farm Sobol (v1: cylinder band + K7 neck, best honest 177.73) + 267 local single-process CMA-ES (farm queue 12-19 jobs all time box); GATE not passed (2nd-half gain 13.44, last-third gain 5.68, top-5 spread 1.06) - keep going: python3 docs/concepts/models/pointer-cslide.py farmcma; mass 741 g Ti (saddle body) vs 125 g champion; red team: overhead abduction 150 contact at hub 1 / link 1 (-15.7 / -14.7 mm), shoe 27-31 mm off in every pose, 8 contact poses, 4 outer-face (torso) contacts

mechanism.notes: counted at the best config (O20 hubs, saddle band, neck 'down'). bodies: link 1, link 2 + C-rail band (one part), shoe + neck (arm-end). joints: J1, J2 O20 hubs, J3 = arm-fixed shoe on the open wire-race band (caged balls; cage excluded as a rolling element, needs anti-creep). custom: base, link 1, link 2, band, shoe + neck, cage, 2 hub shafts, 1 race insert (est.); catalogue: 2 x MR117 pair, 4 race wires, 1 ball set (est.).
